title: Jeweled Oaxacan Baby Squid Tacos
description: A resinous and crisp Oaxacan dish featuring baby squid, infused oil, and ayurvedic-sattvic friendly ingredients, served on a bamboo tray, perfect for a date night.

ingredients.name: baby squid
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into small pieces

ingredients.name: infused oil
ingredients.notes: made with chili peppers and garlic

instructions: Heat the infused oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the baby squid to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the squid from the skillet and set aside on a plate.
Add the sliced red onion to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until softened.
Add the chopped cilantro and cooked squid back to the skillet and stir to combine.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few pieces of the squid mixture onto a tortilla and squeezing with lime juice.
Serve the tacos on a bamboo tray and garnish with pitted dates.
